chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: The Famous Door as Leo Mosley and the Onyx Club
summary: On 52nd Street he follows Charlie Barnet at the Famous Door, working under the name Leo Mosley.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: The closest you ever came to 52nd Street was that Barrell of Fun?
I played the Famous Door. I followed Charlie Barnett there. Then I played the Famous Door when they called it Club 52nd.
I was under Leo Mosley when we played--they changed the club from the Famous Door to Club 52nd, and I went in under the name of Leo Mosley.
Why did you go as Leo Mosley?
That was before I became Snubs.
How did that come about? It's something we can't talk about, no doubt?
